firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
Hello !
I have a quick question, I ran a fine-tuning experiment on Gemma 4 E4B in September. My notes and some results have been in a public GitHub repo since then, as project documentation. It has never been a paper, preprint, or blog post.

My submission would report that experiment along with new analysis and a new held-out test done for this track. Would that be eligible? Happy to disclose the repo in the writeup.

Thank you in advance !
